select b.substance_name as type, a.entity_name as name,a.create_time as add_date,a.create_user as add_by, a.characteristic_value as feature, a.remark as remark from t_cal_artifacts a left join t_cal_std_cats b on a.category_id=b.id
where a.entity_name like concat('%',#{dto.selectKey},'%')
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
